needsDecision.item: Does finalize upload automatically (R-1) or only via the manual `upload <run_dir>` subcommand?
needsDecision.detail: R-1 makes upload a consequence of every successful finalize and R-5 calls the subcommand a recovery path, but the shipped CLI only uploads on an explicit `upload` command and the three orchestrating SKILL.md files never invoke it. AR-04 of the shared spec forbids the skills from writing outside the run folder. One of R-1, AR-04 or the shipped CLI has to change; the spec must say which.

needsDecision.item: Extend the kind enumeration to `requirements`, or declare requirements-review results out of scope?
needsDecision.detail: R-0, R-1, R-2, R-7, R-8, R-8a, R-9 and R-14 enumerate `test|code` only. The shared spec's run-folder layout, the `adversarial-requirements-review` skill and the shipped uploader/API/SPA already carry a third kind. This is a tightened SHALL relative to the shared spec: an R-7-conformant IAM policy denies the third partition and an R-9-conformant reader rejects this very run folder.

needsDecision.item: Keep or drop `nextToken` pagination in R-35?
needsDecision.detail: R-35 requires a cursor and a Load-more/scroll control; R-8 requires a bare JSON array; design and tasks implement neither cursor nor control. Decide which half of the spec is the oracle.

needsDecision.item: Run selector default: auto-select newest run (R-18) or placeholder option?
needsDecision.detail: R-18 requires `runs[0]` to be selected (which fires a findings request on every kind switch); the shipped selector renders a placeholder `— select a run —` and issues no request until the user picks. Spec or code must move.

needsDecision.item: Which user-visible strings are the oracle?
needsDecision.detail: R-17 says `No {kind} review runs yet.`; shipped says `No {kind} review runs found.` Design §5.6 says `No findings match the active filters.`; shipped says `No findings match the current filters.` R-19 omits the `({verdict})` suffix the shipped label appends. A conformance test needs one text.

needsDecision.item: Requirement ids were renumbered between v0.1.0 and v0.2.0; code comments and tasks.md still cite v0.1.0 ids.
needsDecision.detail: The shipped stale-response guard cites `R-20, R-24` (v0.2.0: loading indicator and banner) where v0.2.0 numbers it R-29; tasks.md declares itself derived from v0.1.0. Confirm the renumbering is intended and that tasks.md/code citations will be re-based, otherwise the citation audit will pass on ids that mean something else.
